children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Publish a local module bundle into an upload source, validate synchronization, and install the exact version safely.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Module bundles are executable infrastructure content; reject an unexpected digest or policy state.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Only an Upload ModuleSource accepts a local archive; validate the bundle before it leaves authoring.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Configure at least one source of type Upload.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Package metadata, template, assets, schema, and version as .tar.gz.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Validate identity, semver, capabilities, images, supported versions, and locales (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Choose the upload source and archive, then verify catalog identity and provenance after synchronization.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Open Modules → Upload module and select the target source.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Wait for sync and locate the exact name and version.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Confirm source, digest, verification, policy, and capability summary.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Install the exact version, test every declared capability, and publish a new version instead of mutating a released archive.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Verify name, version, source, digest, policy, capabilities after sync

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Install exact version → canary all capabilities → keep rollback release

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
